layers.name: artifact.tokens
constraints: The variables graph is artifact-local; cross-artifact and cross-project reuse belongs in a later resources layer.
Figma VARIABLE_SET and VARIABLE nodes are compiled before non-rendering metadata nodes are filtered from artifact.scene.
Bindings store both scenePath for import-time default application and componentPath for runtime ECS updates.

layers.name: flamo.variables
layers.signature: listCollections | listVariables | getCollection | getVariable | getActiveMode | getValue | resolveValue | setMode | override | clearOverride | clearOverrides | reset | subscribe
constraints: setMode validates collection and mode IDs before changing active mode.
override is runtime-local and takes precedence over the active mode value.
getValue resolves alias values by default with cycle and maximum-depth protection; pass resolveAlias: false to inspect the alias edge.
Each mounted instance owns its active modes and overrides by default; modeScope: app is an explicit opt-in.
Mode and override writes enqueue component-path updates for bound scene targets.

layers.name: authoring.variables
layers.signature: create/update/delete collection, mode, variable, binding; setVariableValue; validate; applyPatch
constraints: Authoring APIs mutate artifact.tokens.variables with structured operations.
applyPatch validates all operations against a graph copy and commits atomically; dryRun returns the planned receipt without committing.
Destructive deletes fail closed unless explicit cascade or fallback options are supplied.
validate reports invalid modes and values, alias cycles and type mismatches, and invalid or duplicate binding targets.
